items.text: the tele pages get section rows in a rounded card with explanatory text, and a search result opens the page scrolled to the setting.
items.where: settings → tele, settings search

items.text: the onboarding and permission prompts name the app too.
items.where: launcher, onboarding, settings

items.text: the fork's own texts are capitalized, like telegram's.
items.where: settings → tele

items.text: pick the people whose messages tele hides in the chat and in the chat list: every peer is hidden completely or faded.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → ignored → ignored users

items.text: the profile of a person gets an "Ignore messages" row that hides their messages for you.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → ignored → show the ignore button in the profile

items.text: the ignored users picker is its own screen with the stock chat rows, a search and a done button.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → ignored → ignored users

items.text: the master switch of the ghost options: nothing is hidden while it is off.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → ghost → ghost mode

items.text: the live preview of the ghost mode: the card shows what you show and what the peers see.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → ghost

items.text: ghost a chat even when the global ghost switches are off, or keep a chat visible while they are on.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → ghost → always ghost in / never ghost in

items.text: messages of ghosted chats go out as scheduled, so the server delivers them without marking you online, and tele goes offline again right after the send.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → ghost → send messages as scheduled

items.text: the scheduled message shows up in the chat right away, before the server sends it.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → ghost → show waiting messages in the chat

items.text: the ghost preview shows the read mark in the outgoing bubble instead of the word read, and the stealth icon sits on a circle.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy

items.text: incoming messages that match a word or a java regex are faded.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → hidden words

items.text: the messages that match a word are hidden instead of faded.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → hidden words → hide the messages completely

items.text: ignored people and hidden words stay quiet: no notification, no toast, no mention badge.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → hidden words → mute ignored messages

items.text: briefly show the last seen of a peer that hides it, then restore your own rule.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → peek at hidden last seen

items.text: block screen capture in every window and hide the sender and the message of the notifications.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → streamer mode

items.text: the phone number is hidden in the chat header and in the profile while the streamer mode is on.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → streamer mode

items.text: the rewrite shows a telegram bulletin with what changed instead of a toast, and every rewrite with a random target picks another one.
items.where: settings → tele → privacy → links

items.text: the new in tele page lists the settings that came with the new build, also for a user who updated from tele 1.
items.where: settings → tele → new in tele
